title: 第23章 唐小虎第24章 剑道注解
slug: 顶级悟性从修炼基础剑法开始
lines: 第二十三章唐小虎
连立看着屋门，眼中寒芒不断涌动。
“给脸不要脸，既然如此就怪不得我了。”
连立一脸阴沉的自语道。
原本他以为方羽乃是杜颖儿带来的，以为方羽跟杜颖儿关系匪浅，他其实本意就是想借助方羽巴结杜颖儿。
也正是因为如此，他将方羽安排在桂苑，否则以方羽这刚到杂役堂的新人，根本没有资格住这单间。
后来吃晚膳前，他得到了方羽只是一个矿奴的消息，他就知道自己的投资打水漂了，投错了，当下他就想要抹去这个污点，所以给方羽接了前往天绝峰采药的任务。
只是他没想到方羽，不止没有死在天绝峰，反倒是安然归来，而且看情况收获颇丰。
刚才他瞥了一眼，看到那些灵药，居然有不少一品灵药，其中他还看到了青纹朱果。
“青纹朱果，这小子倒是好运气。”
连立看了一眼桂八，随后冷声自语道，接着连立转身直接离去。
方羽关上门之后，根本不理会连立的想法，而是开始整理这段时间的收获。
一盏茶工夫之后，方羽看着眼前的诸多灵药不由微微一笑。
“五十年以下的一百余株，五十年以上，百年以下的灵药，足足一百株，百年灵药二十一株，二百年灵药十二株，这五天的收获已经够我交付任务了。”
方羽不由低声自语道。
“先用这些灵药来提升修为，以我如今的修为，只有这些一品灵药对我有用，倒是可以拿来炼制成药液，未入品倒是可以当作辅药。”
方羽看着一桌子的灵药，暗自盘算着。
五十年以下的灵药，药力一般，根本无法入品。
五十年以上灵药，根据不同年份药力，分为一品低阶，一品中阶，一品高阶。
正常五十年以上百年以下，为一品低阶，百年以上为一品中阶，达到两百年的为一品高阶。
达到三百年的可为一品巅峰。
当然也有的灵药，品阶本来就很高，虽然年份仅仅五十年，但是品阶却达到一品巅峰的。
方羽看着众多灵药，随后目光落在青纹朱果的身上。
青纹朱果虽然仅仅是一品低阶，但是青纹朱果的药力温和，其中药力单一浑厚，对武者的作用，比之一品高阶的灵药也不遑多让，而且青纹朱果特别适合冲击瓶颈，服用还没有数量限制，朱果内有多少灵气，武者就能够吸收多少。
方羽拿起青纹朱果。
没有迟疑，直接吃了下去。
最后直接施展镇龙桩，引动大地之力开始炼化药力。
这五天的时间，在天绝峰之中，他收获可不止这些带回来的灵药。
在天绝峰，他已然服用了一部分灵药，如今他体内八脉贯通了大半，督脉、冲脉、带脉、阴跷脉、阳跷脉都已然贯通。
只剩下阴维脉和阳维脉没有贯通。
在天绝峰中，他经历无数战斗，以战斗磨砺自身，同时服用各种灵药，让他的修为进境异常快。
如今他准备开始冲击阴维脉，方羽以气劲为主，引动大地之力和轻松纹灵果的灵气，开始不断温养阴维脉。
一刻钟之后，方羽骤然面色一白。
一口鲜血自方羽的口中涌出。
方羽也随之跌坐在地。
“一颗青纹灵果，冲击阴维脉，还是有些捉襟见肘，灵气不够，冲击失败率太高了。”
方羽不由苦笑着自语道。
刚才他用大半的青纹灵果灵气，温养阴维脉，最后以气劲炼化那灵气，对阴维脉发起冲击，但是失败了。
content_en:
Chapter 23 Tang Xiaohu
Lian Li looked at the door of the house, his eyes filled with coldness.
"It's shameless. If that's the case, you can't blame me."
Lian Li said to himself with a gloomy look.
Originally, he thought that Fang Yu was brought by Du Ying'er and that Fang Yu had a close relationship with Du Ying'er. In fact, his original intention was to use Fang Yu to curry favor with Du Ying'er.
It is precisely because of this that he arranged Fang Yu to live in Guiyuan. Otherwise, Fang Yu, a newcomer to the handyman hall, would not be qualified to live in this single room.
Later, before dinner, he got the news that Fang Yu was just a mining slave. He knew that his investment was in vain and he made the wrong investment. He immediately wanted to erase this stain, so he gave Fang Yu the task of collecting herbs at Tianjue Peak.
But he didn't expect that Fang Yu, not only did not die at Tianjue Peak, but returned safely, and judging from the situation, he gained a lot.
He took a glance just now and saw that among those elixirs, there were quite a few first-grade elixirs, among which he also saw blue-striped red fruits.
"Blue stripes and red fruits, this boy is very lucky."
Lian Li glanced at Gui Ba, then murmured to himself coldly, then Lian Li turned around and left directly.
After Fang Yu closed the door, he ignored Lian Li's thoughts and began to sort out what he had gained during this period.
After a cup of tea, Fang Yu couldn't help but smile when he looked at the many elixirs in front of him.
"More than a hundred strains of elixirs that are less than fifty years old, a hundred strains of elixirs that are over fifty years old, and less than a hundred years old, twenty-one strains of elixirs that are one hundred years old, and twelve strains of elixirs that are two hundred years old. The harvest in these five days is enough for me to deliver the task."
Fang Yu couldn't help but whispered to himself.
"First use these elixirs to improve my cultivation. With my current level of cultivation, only these first-grade elixirs are useful to me. They can be used to refine them into medicinal liquids. If they are not of the highest grade, they can be used as auxiliary medicines."
Fang Yu looked at a table of elixirs and thought about it secretly.
The elixirs that are less than fifty years old have mediocre potency and cannot be considered high quality.
Spiritual medicines that are more than fifty years old are divided into low-level products, intermediate-level products, and high-level products according to their potency in different years.
Normally, those who are more than fifty years old and less than one hundred years old are the first-grade low-level ones, those who are more than one hundred years old are the first-grade middle-level ones, and those who have reached two hundred years are the first-grade high-level ones.
Those who have reached three hundred years can be considered the pinnacle of the first rank.
Of course, there are some elixirs that are already of a very high grade. Although they are only fifty years old, their grade reaches the peak of the first grade.
Fang Yu looked at the many elixirs, and then his eyes fell on the blue-striped red fruit.
Although the blue-grained vermilion fruit is only a low-level first-grade medicine, the medicinal power of the blue-grained vermilion fruit is mild, and its potency is single and powerful. Its effect on warriors is no less than that of a high-grade first-grade elixir. Moreover, the blue-grained vermilion fruit is particularly suitable for breaking through bottlenecks. There is no limit on the amount of consumption. The warrior can absorb as much aura as there is in the vermilion fruit.
Fang Yu picked up the blue-grained red fruit.
Without hesitation, he ate it directly.
Finally, he directly used the Dragon Suppressing Stake, activating the power of the earth to start refining the medicinal power.
In these five days in Tianjue Peak, he gained more than just these elixirs he brought back.
At Tianjue Peak, he had already taken part of the elixir, and now most of the eight meridians in his body were connected, including the Du, Chong, Dai, Yin and Yang vessels.
Only the Yin and Yang channels are not connected.
In Tianjue Peak, he experienced countless battles, sharpened himself through battles, and took various elixirs at the same time, which made his cultivation progress extremely quickly.
Now he was ready to attack the Yin-dimensional meridians. Fang Yu focused on Qi Jin, activating the power of the earth and the aura of the Easy Grain Spirit Fruit, and began to continuously warm and nourish the Yin-dimensional meridians.
A quarter of an hour later, Fang Yu suddenly turned pale.
"Pfft."
A mouthful of blood gushes out of Fang Yu's mouth.
Fang Yu also fell to the ground.
"A blue-grained spiritual fruit is still a bit weak to impact the Yin dimension veins. The spiritual energy is not enough, and the failure rate of the impact is too high."
Fang Yu couldn't help but smiled bitterly and said to himself.
Just now, he used most of the blue-grained spirit fruit's spiritual energy to warm and nourish the Yin-dimensional meridians. Finally, he used his energy to refine the spiritual energy and launched an attack on the Yin-dimensional meridians, but failed.
